packages.title: DESNZ Energy Trends and Prices statistical release: 30 June 2026 — scope and status QA
facts: DESNZ published the Energy Trends and Prices statistical release on 30 June 2026.
The release provides the latest provisional monthly UK energy production, trade, electricity generation, consumption and price statistics.
Energy statistics are provided in total and by fuel including coal, oil, gas and electricity.
Monthly provisional energy activity data must remain distinct from measured greenhouse-gas emissions unless an explicit accepted conversion method is applied.
No parcel-level emissions value is inferred from the national monthly energy release.

packages.title: DESNZ Energy Consumption in the UK 2025 — scope and status QA
facts: Energy Consumption in the UK 2025 was published on 25 September 2025 and last updated on 20 April 2026.
The publication covers overall UK energy consumption with industry, transport, domestic and services sectors.

packages.title: DESNZ Greenhouse gas reporting conversion factors 2026 — scope and status QA
facts: DESNZ published the 2026 greenhouse-gas reporting conversion factors on 11 June 2026.
The factors enable users to calculate and report emissions from UK activity data such as fuel volume, purchased electricity and distance travelled.
The publication distinguishes Scope 1, Scope 2 and Scope 3 reporting uses.
DESNZ notes that these activity-based factors differ from Defra spend-based emissions multipliers.
Conversion factors are calculation inputs, not direct parcel emissions observations.
